pictures.shows: Start of a sale on the ZZ TEST till: the customer half (right) shows "Choose your language", the same question in the other four languages beneath, and the language cards, each in its own language. No keypad, no small language button. Staff half (left) waits for the customer.
The same choice scrolled to its end: all five cards, English, 中文, ไทย, Русский, Français, with "Continue in …" in each language.

After a tap on ไทย: the customer half shows the phone-number step in Thai, "เบอร์โทรศัพท์ของคุณคืออะไร?", the safety line "เราขอเบอร์โทรศัพท์ทุกครั้งที่มา…", the keypad with ล้าง, and the small language button in the corner reading ไทย. The staff half stays in English.

The same Thai phone step scrolled down: the keypad with its ล้าง (Clear) key and backspace, the contact channel choice and the optional nickname "ชื่อเล่น (ไม่บังคับ)", and the Thai Continue button "ดำเนินการต่อ". The small language button (top right) still reads ไทย when scrolled back.

After the number, staff chose "Continue as walk-in": the customer half shows the welcome in Thai, "ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Oto", with the small language button reading ไทย. The language choice did not come back.

Tourist, 1 Hour Play, 1 kid + 1 adult in the cart: the customer half shows the order in Thai, "คำสั่งซื้อของคุณ" beside the small language button reading ไทย. The language choice did not come back between steps; the staff half stays in English.

The small language button on the order screen switched the customer half to Français: "Votre commande" beside the button reading Français, the ticket and totals in French. The language choice screen did not reappear.

The sale paid in cash (receipt Z763-000001): the staff half shows Payment Successful; the customer half thanks the guest in French. The language choice has not come back yet: the sale is still on screen.

After Start New Sale: the customer half shows the language choice again for the next guest, headed in the last guest's language, "Choisissez votre langue", with the question in the other four languages beneath and the cards each in its own language. No keypad, no small language button.
Cancel pressed on the till while the language choice was on screen: the next sale opens on the same choice (still headed in French, the last guest's language). No sale was written.

A guest chose 中文 and reached the phone step in Chinese, then staff pressed Cancel on the till (the guest walked away): the language choice is back for the next guest, headed in Chinese, "请选择您的语言", with the other four beneath. No sale was written.
Before the cancel: a second guest chose 中文; the walk-in order (1 Hour Play, 1 kid + 1 adult, not paid) shows in Chinese, "您的订单", with the small language button reading 中文.

Cancel on the till with the unpaid Chinese order in the cart: the order empties and the customer half shows the language choice again for the next guest, headed in Chinese. No sale was written (only price quotes).

A separate customer display paired to the ZZ TEST till (its own browser context, 1024 x 768, paired with the display page's own code): its first screen is the same language choice, "Choose your language" and the five cards. No keypad, no small language button.
After Русский on the paired display: the phone step in Russian, "Ваш номер телефона?", with the Russian safety line and the small language button reading Русский; the keypad's Очистить key is below.

The ZZ TEST till at the same moment: "Display connected: ZZ TEST SCRUM-763 display", its own customer half gone (the paired display has the customer), and the staff half in English, waiting for the customer.

Observation, not a pass: after Cancel on the till (sale reset while it was still on its first screen), the paired display stays on the Russian phone step; it did not reopen the language choice. Virtual box 1 runs in oto-api-staging, which is at ed6e092d and does not carry 36f19edee (the box keeping the sale name on the first screen), so the display cannot tell this is a new sale.
